refnamediv.refpurpose: Get and/or set the current session save path

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.parameters;
path
Session data path. If specified and not &null;, the path to which data is saved will be changed. session_save_path needs to be called before session_start for that purpose.
The value has the same format as the session.save_path configuration directive, and may be of the form N;MODE;path, where N is the number of directory levels and MODE the octal file mode. An empty string makes the default files handler use the system temporary directory.
On some operating systems, you may want to specify a path on a filesystem that handles lots of small files efficiently.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the value of session.save_path as it was before the call, exactly as it was set, including any N;MODE; prefix. This is an empty string if no path has been configured. If path is given, it is the previous value, not the new one. Returns &false; if path is given and a session is active or headers have already been sent; an E_WARNING is emitted and the path is not changed.
